answer.note: Integrity counts are over the claim inventory (catalog confirmation outputs, named gates, and detector-control fixtures). three_state ABSENT/EMPTY/GENUINE_ZERO is the measurement shape and is not merged. The confirmation corpus directory was missing before this artifact was written; catalog confirmation files remain ABSENT except this unit.

claim_under_test: Unmeasured confirmation and gate items were counted as passes, and absent directories were treated as empty result sets or genuine zeros.

evidence.claim: Absent directories are classified ABSENT, never as genuine zero / nothing to check.
evidence.snippet: an absent artifact directory is not evidence of nothing to check

evidence.claim: Unrunnable enforcement commands emit NOT-CHECKED rather than a silent pass.
evidence.snippet: a gate whose enforcement command cannot run emits NOT-CHECKED, not a silent pass

evidence.claim: The planted unlabelled no-probe receipt is the folded-into-pass detector control.
evidence.snippet: unlabelled item with no probe lands in folded-into-pass
an absent artifact directory must never be reported as evidence of nothing to check

evidence.claim: Known-broken unlabelled pass with no probe.
Catalog output_schema resolves to the confirmation-audit class shim.

question: Was anything unmeasured quietly counted as a pass? Audit every confirmation and every gate output for items with no probe, and answer: how many are correctly recorded as NOT-CHECKED, how many are absent entirely, and how many were folded into a pass? An absent directory, an empty result set and a genuine zero are three different states and must not be merged.

reviewer.method: Re-run classify.controls and checker.check_artifact on the live artifact; apply naive_absent_as_zero and naive_unrunnable_as_pass mutants and require the checker to fail both.

sentinel: SUCCESS:CNF-0120 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and every item carries one of the three states with the distinguishing evidence, and the planted unlabelled item was caught. Any other terminal state is FAILED:CNF-0120 <classification> with the diagnostic tail attached.
